slides.title: UN releases $3M for people who fled Moyale
slides.body: Nearly 50,000 are now in Kenya, UN aid chief says.

slides.title: Emergency fund approved
slides.body: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher says $3M from CERF will fund food, water, shelter and health.

slides.title: Where they are
slides.body: Mostly with host families in Moyale Sub-County, Kenya. Most new arrivals are women and children, per Kenyans.co.ke.

slides.title: Wider appeal
slides.body: UN agencies asked Nov 5 for $8.9M to help up to 50,000 people for three months.

slides.title: Aid access and protection for civilians
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
